sermon.title: What do Good Leaders Have? — August 28, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Good leaders walk in the fear of God. Nehemiah rebuked nobles who oppressed their brethren with interest and servitude; Joseph, Josiah and the Hebrew midwives feared God. Exodus 18:21 sets the standard—able, truthful, hating covetousness—for government, church and family.

For there were those who said, “We, our sons, and our daughters are many; therefore let us get grain, that we may eat and live.” There were also some who said, “We have mortgaged our lands and vineyards and houses, that we might buy grain because of the famine.” There were also those who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tax on our lands and vineyards. Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children; and indeed we are forcing our sons and our daughters to be slaves, and some of our daughters have been brought into slavery. scriptures.text_nkjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
Let God arise, Let His enemies be scattered; Let those also who hate Him flee before Him.

faqs.question: How much difference does interest make?
faqs.answer: He compares a $400,000 loan at zero and ten percent.

faqs.question: Are employee laws balanced?
faqs.answer: He says we must find the right balance.

faqs.question: What problem does he see today?
faqs.answer: Nobody will acknowledge they’re wrong and turn.

faqs.question: What interview impressed him?
faqs.answer: A Focus on the Family interview with an official who showed the fear of God.

faqs.question: What did Pharaoh see in Joseph?
faqs.answer: The Spirit of God, discernment and wisdom.

faqs.question: What surprised him?
faqs.answer: That Roe versus Wade was overturned.
